None, as far as I know.
The way this mod is created should make it compatible with every mod out there

The only 2 minor things that you may like to have are
- if you have set a factor on price (like in SVM) then this mod has to be loaded first (so SVM caan apply the factor)
- The keychains will spawn, very very rarely by default. So, If you have a mod that changes the item spawns, it also has to be loaded after this

comments.author: Sharpster3
comments.body_html:
I noticed that my body armors were not able to be put into the “Professional Armor Locker”, despite the description sounding like it would accept them.

I went to look in the config and the config guide, and found the item ID for **Armor** in the config guide, “5448e5284bdc2dcb718b4567”, to be the same ID that was already in the mod config, which was only allowing tactical rigs, armored and non-armored.

I went and looked up the item ID for the “Armor” category and found the list posted by the SPT Team. The Armor ID was “5448e54d4bdc2dcc718b4568”. Additionally, in the config guide, I found out that the **Vests** ID “5448e5724bdc2ddf718b4568” was the ID for “Visor” on the SPT category IDs. This has no impact on container compatibility, but I just wanted to kindly point out the error.

Upon adding the proper armor ID, I was able to place body armor, and any tactical vests inside the case.
